description: Serial terminal, Modbus RTU master and bus sniffer

store.summary: Serial terminal + Modbus RTU master and sniffer for UART/RS232/RS485
store.description:
SerialPuter turns the CardputerZero into a pocket serial tool. Plug a UART, RS232 or RS485 module into the Grove port (or use a USB adapter).

- Terminal: frames split by line pauses or LF, HEX / text / hex+ASCII views, timestamps, send text with escapes and line endings or raw bytes with an optional Modbus CRC, history, scroll-back, log to file
- Modbus RTU master: read coils, inputs, holding and input registers; poll; scan addresses 1-247
- Values as U16, I16, HEX, U32, I32 and float with ABCD or CDAB word order
- Sniffer: Modbus frames are labelled (request, response with register numbers, exceptions) and glued frames are split by CRC
- 1200 to 921600 baud, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 / 7E1 / 7O1 (the built-in mini UART does 8N1 / 7N1)
- SIM port: a demo bus with a BMS, an inverter and a modem to try everything without hardware

Read-only for Modbus: nothing is written to your devices. Tab switches TERM / MODBUS / PORT, F1 shows help.
